pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-sized, irregularly polygonal patches with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch pigmentation is a consistent tan, distributed with high spatial frequency across the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A robust network of light cream-colored inter-patch corridors. Junctions are characterized by tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes. The negative-space pathways exhibit consistent pixel thickness.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the dorsal mane. The silhouette is clearly defined against the out-of-focus background foliage.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Presence of a perched avian subject on the dorsal ridge of the neck creates a localized structural break in the mane's continuous line.

other_distinctive_markers: Two avian subjects (oxpeckers) are present on the giraffe's body: one positioned on the upper dorsal neck/shoulder junction and another on the lower posterior flank near the underbelly.
